paper.title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds
paper.reference: Fama and French, Journal of Financial Economics 33:3–56 (1993), doi:10.1016/0304-405X(93)90023-5

paper_context.research_question: Do the published six size/book-to-market portfolio returns reconstruct the official SMB and HML factors for a fixed historical month?
paper_context.method: Download both official CSV archives, hash them, and recompute January 2020 SMB and HML from the documented equations.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Kenneth French Data Library public monthly factor and 2x3 portfolio archives; January 2020 only is evaluated.
paper_context.training_or_inference: No training; two small HTTPS downloads and arithmetic.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: Compare reconstructed and published factors, allowing one basis point for source rounding.
paper_context.limitations: The official archives are live and unsigned; response SHA-256 values are recorded, raw archives are not redistributed, and no causal asset-pricing claim is tested.

claims.protocol: Compare reconstructed and published factors, allowing one basis point for source rounding.
